title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify user can successfully register with valid personal and contact information and correct password strength.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page
Enter valid personal and contact information
Input a strong password meeting password policy requirements
Submit the registration form
Confirm registration is successful and user receives confirmation

title: User Registration with Weak Password
description: Verify system rejects registration if password does not meet strength criteria with proper error message.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page
Enter valid personal and contact information
Input a weak password (e.g., less than required length)
Submit the registration form
Verify registration is rejected with descriptive password strength error

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that a user can log in successfully with correct username/email and password, receiving a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input valid username/email and correct password
Click the login button
Check login succeeds and JWT token is issued

title: User Login with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify login fails with invalid username/email or password and a proper error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Input invalid or non-existent username/email or wrong password
Click the login button
Verify login is denied with appropriate error message

title: KYC Document Upload with Valid File
description: Verify users can upload allowed document types (PDF, JPG, PNG) under 5MB and file is accepted for KYC submission.

steps.description: Log in as a user
Navigate to document upload page
Select and upload a valid document file (PDF, JPG, or PNG) less than 5MB
Confirm file upload is successful and file appears in document list

title: KYC Document Upload with Invalid File Type
description: Verify system rejects upload of disallowed file types with an appropriate error message.

steps.description: Log in as a user
Navigate to document upload page
Attempt to upload a file of unsupported type (e.g., .exe, .txt)
Verify upload is rejected with proper invalid file type error

title: KYC Document Upload Exceeding Size Limit
description: Verify upload fails with files larger than 5MB and appropriate error message is returned.

steps.description: Log in as a user
Navigate to document upload page
Attempt to upload a valid file type exceeding 5MB
Verify upload is rejected with file size limit error

title: KYC Submission Without Required Documents
description: Verify users cannot submit KYC application without uploading all required documents (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport as applicable).

steps.description: Log in as a user
Navigate to documents page without uploading all required documents
Attempt to submit KYC application
Verify submission is blocked with message specifying missing required documents

title: KYC Submission Workflow Success
description: Verify that after uploading valid required documents, user can submit KYC application which appears in admin pending queue.

steps.description: Log in as a user
Upload all required valid documents
Submit the KYC application
Confirm submission success and application appears pending in admin panel

title: Admin Reviews and Approves KYC Application
description: Verify admin is able to log in, view pending KYC applications, access uploaded documents, and approve an application with audit trail recording.

steps.description: Log in as admin
Navigate to admin pending KYC requests queue
Select a pending KYC application and review documents
Approve the KYC application
Confirm application status changes to approved and audit trail entry is created

title: Admin Rejects KYC Application with Mandatory Reason
description: Verify admin must provide a rejection reason when rejecting KYC application and that action is logged in audit trail.

steps.description: Log in as admin
Navigate to admin pending KYC requests queue
Select a pending KYC application and review documents
Attempt to reject the application without entering rejection reason
Verify rejection is blocked and error requesting mandatory reason is shown
Enter valid rejection reason and confirm rejection
Confirm application status changes to rejected and audit trail records rejection with reason

title: Add Financial Transaction and Verify Credit Score Update
description: Verify user can add credit and debit transactions with proper metadata, and credit score is recalculated accurately.

steps.description: Log in as user
Navigate to transactions page
Add a new credit transaction with valid amount and metadata
Confirm transaction is saved successfully
Verify user credit score is recalculated and updated according to weighted algorithm

title: View and Filter Financial Transactions
description: Verify user can view transaction list, use pagination and apply filters (credit/debit, date range) successfully.

steps.description: Log in as user
Navigate to transactions page
Apply filter to show only credit transactions
Verify only credit transactions are displayed
Navigate through pages of transactions using pagination controls
Verify pagination works and correct data is displayed per page

title: Verify Dashboard Displays Accurate KYC Status and Credit Score
description: Verify dashboard shows correct user KYC verification status, current credit score between 300-900, and financial summary data.

steps.description: Log in as user
Navigate to dashboard page
Confirm dashboard shows current KYC status (pending/approved/rejected)
Verify credit score displayed is within range 300-900 and matches calculated value
Verify financial transaction summaries are shown accurately

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify users cannot access admin or partner endpoints or UI views, admins cannot access user-only features, and partners have limited access per role.

steps.description: Log in as a user
Attempt to access admin panel or admin API endpoint
Verify access is denied with proper authorization error
Log in as partner
Attempt to access admin or user-only pages/APIs
Verify restricted access enforced
Log in as admin
Attempt to access user-only features not permitted to admin
Verify access denied as per role policies

title: Partner API Access with Valid OAuth-like Account Linking
description: Verify third-party partners can securely link accounts via OAuth-like flow, obtain valid API keys, and retrieve authorized user data with user consent.

steps.description: Simulate partner initiating OAuth-like account linking flow
User grants consent for partner data access
Partner receives valid API key and access token
Partner calls API to retrieve user KYC status and credit score
Verify data returned is correct and only accessible with valid tokens and consent

title: Partner API Access with Invalid or Missing API Key
description: Verify partner API endpoints reject requests with missing or invalid API keys or expired tokens with appropriate error responses.

steps.description: Send API request to partner endpoint without API key
Verify request is rejected with unauthorized error
Send API request with invalid or expired API key
Verify request is rejected with token invalid or expired error

title: API Request Validation for User Registration and Transactions
description: Verify incoming API requests for registration and transaction creation fail with consistent validation error responses on invalid input data.

steps.description: Send registration API request with missing required fields or invalid email format
Verify response contains structured validation error messages
Send transaction creation API request with invalid amount (negative or zero) or missing type
Verify validation errors are returned consistently in response

title: Global Error Handling Middleware Consistency
description: Verify errors thrown from different API layers are handled by the global error middleware returning consistent error formats.

steps.description: Trigger known server error (e.g., database unavailable)
Server returns consistent error response format with status code and descriptive message
Send API request with invalid JWT token
Error response follows global error format with unauthorized status

title: Security Verification of JWT Expiration and Password Hashing
description: Verify JWT tokens expire as configured and password hashing is implemented securely using bcrypt with sufficient rounds.

steps.description: Obtain JWT token after login
Wait for token expiration time and attempt API access
Verify access is denied due to expired token
Inspect stored user password hash in database
Confirm password is stored as bcrypt hash with configured rounds

title: CORS Configuration Enforcement
description: Verify that API endpoints enforce CORS policy allowing requests only from allowed origins.

steps.description: Send API request from an allowed origin
Verify request succeeds with appropriate CORS headers
Send API request from a disallowed origin
Verify request is blocked or CORS headers deny access
